method.method_draft: Use a vector/coordinate parametrization. Read from the diagram/text that ABCD is a parallelogram, F lies on the extension of AD beyond D, and along line BF the order is F-G-E-B, with GF=24 and EF=32. Set A as the origin, let B be vector b, D be vector d, so C=b+d and F=t d for some t>1. Parametrize points on BF by P(s)=F+s(B-F), where s is the fraction of the full segment BF measured from F. For G on DC, equate P(s)=d+u b to get s_G=1-1/t. For E on AC, equate P(s)=v(b+d), giving s_E=t/(t+1). Since distances along BF scale by the same parameter, s_E/s_G=EF/GF=32/24=4/3. Solve for t, obtaining t=2, hence s_E=2/3. Therefore BF=EF/s_E=32/(2/3)=48, so BE=BF-EF=48-32=16.

G 在 DC 上，DC 上的点可写成 d+u b。比较 d 的系数，有 t(1-s_G)=1，因此 s_G=1-1/t。

E 在 AC 上，AC 上的点可写成 v(b+d)。比较 b 和 d 的系数，有 s_E=v 且 t(1-s_E)=v=s_E，所以 t(1-s_E)=s_E，得到 s_E=t/(t+1)。

于是 s_E=t/(t+1)=2/3。因为 EF=s_E·BF，所以 BF=32/(2/3)=48。最后 BE=BF-EF=48-32=16。

method.method_draft: Use a triangle-similarity plus affine-ratio lemma. Let L=BF. From the diagram/text, G lies on BF and DC is parallel to AB, so in triangle FAB, segment DG is parallel to AB. Thus triangles FDG and FAB are similar, giving FD/FA=FG/FB=24/L. Now use the parallelogram bridge: in triangle FAB, if D is on FA with r=FD/FA and C is formed by drawing through D a line parallel to AB and through B a line parallel to FA, then AC meets FB at E with FE/FB=1/(2-r). This lemma can be justified by an affine normalization of triangle FAB or barycentric coordinates. Here r=24/L and FE/FB=32/L, so 32/L=1/(2-24/L). Solving gives L=48, since L must exceed EF=32. Therefore BE=L-EF=48-32=16.
